_comment: Matches benchmarking/config_multi_column.json's explicit 'columns' schema (source field names level/duration_ms/success/ctx must line up exactly for the sink's superset-schema lookup to find them) - level is a string column, duration_ms an Int64 column, success a Bool column, and ctx a String column fed from a nested map so the sink's JSON-encoding-of-non-string-values path gets exercised.
